newsitem.title: USA: Southern, United Carolina merger approved.
newsitem.headline: Southern, United Carolina merger approved.

text.p: Shareholders of Southern National Corp and United Carolina Bancshares have approved in separate meetings the merger of their two companies, which is expected to be completed July 1, Southern said Tuesday.

It said Southern's shareholders also approved a change in the name of the holding company to BB&T Corp, a move that ties the corporate name to the name of the company's banking subsidiaries in Virginia and North and South Carolina.
Southern National operates banks in the three states under the BB&T name, it added.
Southern said United Carolina Bank and United Carolina Bank of South Carolina will merge into Branch Banking & Trust Co (BB&T) and BB&T of South Carolina.
The change in the name of the holding company from Southern National Corporation to BB&T Corporation is expected to become effective by May 16.
Shares will begin trading on the exchange under a new symbol, BBK, on the New York Stock Exchange.
